visual.observation: A slide presents a job opportunity as “BPO job in IBM Technical Support Associate” with “IBM India Pvt. Limited Hyderabad” and an IBM logo.
visual.context: Unclear context; the sampled frames show a slideshow-style job posting and do not show verification of the employer or poster.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible IBM branding and company-name claim are linked to a recruitment opportunity, which conditionally merits review as an identity/endorsement claim connected to a job action path.
visual.limitations: The frames cannot establish whether IBM authorized the posting, whether the opportunity is genuine, or who created the video.

visual.observation: Recruitment slides ask candidates to attend a “professional discussion” and describe eligibility such as zero to one year experience, graduate criteria, and technical support associate duties.
visual.context: The content appears to describe a job recruitment process; promotion versus reposted informational content is unclear from the frames alone.
visual.potential_relevance: A stated invitation to join/attend a professional discussion is connected to a branded job opportunity, making the requested recruitment action conditionally relevant for review.
visual.limitations: No application link, contact destination, interview address, or actual follow-through is visible in these sampled frames.

visual.observation: Several slides instruct candidates to carry documents, including soft copies on a USB drive, current offer/appraisal letter, experience letters, recent pay slips, resume, government ID proof, education mark sheets, degree certificate, and a printout of an email with original government-approved photo ID for entry.
visual.context: The slides present these as documents required for an in-person discussion/security entry in a recruitment setting.
visual.potential_relevance: The job opportunity is linked to a request for sensitive employment, salary, identity, and education documents, which conditionally merits review because personal-data submission is tied to the recruitment action.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show where documents would be submitted, whether any data is actually collected, or whether the document request is legitimate for the stated recruitment process.

visual.observation: One slide says salary is “Not Disclosed by Recruiter” while listing industry, functional area, role category, role, and employment type as permanent full-time.
visual.context: The slide appears to provide ordinary job details within the recruitment slideshow.
visual.potential_relevance: Compensation is withheld while other job conditions are provided, which may be relevant as a recruitment-condition cue when viewed alongside the branded job invitation and document requests.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show any fee, payment request, promised salary amount, or outcome for applicants.

visual_context_notes.observation: A recurring watermark “WWW.LEAWO.COM” is visible across the slideshow frames.
Multiple slides include “Please Subscribe to ThatsUpload,” and the final slide asks viewers to like, subscribe, comment, click a bell icon, and be alert.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a technical-support recruitment opportunity with role duties, graduate eligibility, and employment conditions rather than a return, investment, or payment-based offer. The document and identification requests are framed as materials for a professional discussion or premises visit, and the subscribe and notification prompts are ordinary audience engagement rather than a condition of obtaining the job or participating in recruitment.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an ordinary recruitment and employment-service presentation describing a technical-support role, eligibility, employment type and recruitment materials. The supplied evidence does not establish a payment request, investment return, task-income flow or other scam mechanism.
